review_type: Internal mathematical audit; no independent referee or priority certificate
model: Two independent IID samples, fixed bounded known positive utility scale, fixed finite logistic signal, fixed strictly interior low-index predictor, conditionally independent Gaussian remaining attributes, fitted scaled intercept

checked_arguments.finite_design_scale_interval_identity: Scale goes into residual intervals; one shared conic multiplier
checked_arguments.nuisance_qualification: Scale-weighted support rho_D; positive minimum over unit affine directions
checked_arguments.relative_interior: Qualified nuisance intersection plus generic polyhedral-face transversality
checked_arguments.curvature_rank: All rows below unit power; auxiliary rows at unit power; strict phase sides only
checked_arguments.statistical_dimension_limit: Expectation outside empirical inf-sup; multiplier/scale localization; compact uniform laws and uniform integrability
checked_arguments.balanced_multiplier: Sign averaging establishes zero multiplier for every fixed scale
checked_arguments.strict_scale_cost: Unique positive maximum of the strongly concave common profile
checked_arguments.same_information_counterexample: Full population score covariance and Hessian matched; labelled-only separation identical samplewise
checked_arguments.small_and_large_auxiliary_limits: Proportional limit at each fixed auxiliary ratio precedes ratio limits
checked_arguments.held_power_control: Nondecreasing balanced population boundary by concave perspective

excluded_extensions: scale support changing with sample size
arbitrary correlated attributes or respondent clusters
finite-sample monotonicity when auxiliary rows increase
